assertions.evidence_text: Section 188 of WIOA does not authorize the Department to require affirmative outreach.
assertions.rationale: The sentence expressly denies that Section 188 grants the specified authority.

assertions.evidence_text: A profit-sharing, stock bonus, pre-ERISA money purchase pension, or rural cooperative plan does not fail to satisfy the requirements of section 401(a) merely because the plan includes a cash or deferred arrangement.
assertions.rationale: The double-negative construction establishes that a profit-sharing plan does satisfy section 401(a) despite containing the arrangement.

assertions.evidence_text: The assessment rate will remain in effect indefinitely unless modified, suspended, or terminated.
assertions.rationale: The rate is stated to remain in effect indefinitely, subject to the express unless-condition.

assertions.evidence_text: It’s beyond my understanding why the FCC would think that our local ABC station does not provide a service to our communities.
assertions.rationale: The filer rejects the proposition that the local ABC station does not provide community service, thereby attributing the affirmative proposition to the filer.

of that language published with all prior

assertions.rationale: Prior preamble explanations and interpretations are retained for unchanged language, subject to the stated modification exception.

assertions.evidence_text: 29 CFR 38.40 contains affirmative outreach requirements for recipients of financial assistance under Title I of WIOA.
assertions.rationale: The operative text expressly states that 29 CFR 38.40 contains affirmative outreach requirements; their proposed removal does not alter this current statement.
